buttons.label: Selection Helpers
buttons.tooltip: Select joints influencing selection - right-click for more
buttons.command:
import maya.cmds as cmds
sel = cmds.ls(sl=True)
if sel:
    hist = cmds.listHistory(sel, pruneDagObjects=True) or []
    scs = cmds.ls(hist, type='skinCluster')
    joints = list({j for sc in scs for j in (cmds.skinCluster(sc, q=True, influence=True) or [])})
    cmds.select(joints) if joints else cmds.warning('No skinCluster found on selection')
else:
    cmds.warning('Nothing selected')

popup.command:
import maya.cmds as cmds

popup.label: Select objects influenced by selected joints
popup.command:
import maya.cmds as cmds
joints = cmds.ls(sl=True, type='joint')
if joints:
    meshes = list({g for j in joints for sc in (cmds.listConnections(j, type='skinCluster') or []) for g in (cmds.skinCluster(sc, q=True, geometry=True) or [])})
    cmds.select(meshes) if meshes else cmds.warning('No skin bindings found')
else:
    cmds.warning('Select joints first')

popup.label: Select unskinned meshes
popup.command:
import maya.cmds as cmds
from maya_tools.framework import utilities as u
meshes = u.scene_mesh_shapes()
unskinned = [cmds.listRelatives(m, parent=True, fullPath=True)[0] for m in meshes if not cmds.ls(cmds.listHistory(m, pruneDagObjects=True) or [], type='skinCluster')]
cmds.select(unskinned) if unskinned else cmds.inViewMessage(msg='All meshes are skinned', pos='midCenter', fade=True)

popup.label: Create locator at center of selected
popup.command:
import maya.cmds as cmds
sel = cmds.ls(sl=True, fl=True)
if sel:
    pts = [cmds.pointPosition(s, w=True) for s in sel]
    n = len(pts)
    loc = cmds.spaceLocator()[0]
    cmds.move(sum(p[0] for p in pts)/n, sum(p[1] for p in pts)/n, sum(p[2] for p in pts)/n, loc, ws=True)
else:
    cmds.warning('Nothing selected')
